about_the_game:
Shaolin Strategy is a retro-inspired 2D adventure blending platforming and strategy. Lead a team of skilled warriors on a quest to defeat the evil Black Dominion.

Features:

  • Unique gameplay! Characters take turns running, jumping, and attacking enemies across 2D stages.

  • Each party member wields unique abilities that can be combined to solve puzzles and outmaneuver foes. Place a bomb with one character and have another light it up to destroy a wide area, or set a trap and pull an enemy into it with a chain whip!

  • Gameplay starts easy and gradually ramps up as you become more familiar with the mechanics. Strategic positioning and planning are rewarded!

  • Short but sweet story. Meet charming characters with their own life perspectives.

  • Game design, pixel art graphics, and a retro-inspired soundtrack created by a single developer.
